title: ARIRANG World Tour Debuts at Gillette Stadium, Foxborough
detail: August 5-6, 2026 — BTS performs at Gillette Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts for the first time, marking the largest headlining K-pop shows ever held at the venue. The in-the-round staging places the audience at the center of the show, continuing the ARIRANG World Tour's North American return leg after the MetLife Stadium opener.

media.caption: BTS makes its first appearance at Gillette Stadium, the largest headlining K-pop show in the venue's history.
